Title: Login with valid email and incorrect password
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter incorrect password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message shown and user is not logged in
Actual Result: Your email or password is incorrect!

Title: Login with unregistered email
Preconditions: Email is not associated with any account
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter unregistered email; 3. Enter any password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Generic error identical to the wrong-password case
Actual Result: Your email or password is incorrect!
Notes: Same message observed as incorrect-password case

Title: Login with both fields empty
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Leave both fields empty; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Submission blocked and required-field prompt shown

Title: Login with invalid email format (missing @)
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter email without @; 3. Enter any password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Format validation message shown before submission
Actual Result: Please include an '@' in the email address. 'testuser.com' is missing an '@'.

Title: Login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter correct password; 4. Click Login
Test Data: Email: valid email; Password: correct password
Expected Result: User is logged in and the logged-in indicator is shown

Title: Logout after login
Test Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials; 2. Click Logout link
Expected Result: User is logged out and redirected to login page
Actual Result: User successfully logged out and URL changed to /login

Title: Login with SQL injection attempt
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter SQL injection string in email; 3. Enter password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails with error or SQL injection is prevented
column11: Security test - requires manual verification with network inspection

Title: Signup with new user then delete account
Test Steps: 1. Open signup page; 2. Fill signup form with new email; 3. Submit; 4. Fill account info; 5. Create account; 6. Delete account
Test Data: Email: random new email; Name: test user
Expected Result: Account created successfully with confirmation message 'ACCOUNT CREATED!'; then deletion confirmation 'ACCOUNT DELETED!' shown
Actual Result: Account created and deleted successfully with both confirmation messages

Title: Signup with existing email
Test Steps: 1. Open signup page; 2. Enter existing email; 3. Submit
Expected Result: Error message 'Email Address already exist!' displayed below signup form

Title: Signup with invalid email format
Test Steps: 1. Open signup page; 2. Enter invalid email; 3. Enter name; 4. Click Signup
Expected Result: Browser validation prevents submission with message 'Please include an '@' in the email address'

Title: Search for existing product
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Enter product name in search; 3. Click search
Expected Result: Search results page displays with heading 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' and at least one product card containing 'Top' in the name
Actual Result: Products containing 'Top' displayed under SEARCHED PRODUCTS heading

Title: Search for nonexistent product
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Enter nonexistent term in search; 3. Click search
Expected Result: Search results page displays 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' heading with zero product cards shown
Actual Result: Searched Products title shown with empty product list

Title: Products page displays product cards
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /products page
Expected Result: Page displays 'ALL PRODUCTS' heading and at least 20 product cards with images and names visible
Actual Result: 34 product cards visible with ALL PRODUCTS heading

Title: First product has name and price
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /products page; 2. Locate first product card
Expected Result: First product card displays product name (text) and price in format 'Rs. [amount]'
Actual Result: Product displays name and price Rs. 500

Title: View individual product details
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Click View Product on first item
Expected Result: Product detail page shows: product name; category (e.g. Women > Tops); price; availability status; condition (New); brand name; full description paragraph; product images
Notes: Detailed view - not critical for basic cart flow

Title: Filter products by category
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Click on category in left sidebar (e.g. Women > Tops); 3. Verify products
Expected Result: Page displays only products matching selected category; heading updates to show category name; product count matches category selection
Notes: Category filtering - advanced feature not required for MVP

Title: Add product to cart and verify it appears
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Get first product name; 3. Click Add to Cart; 4. Navigate to cart page
Expected Result: Cart page shows: product name matching the added product; product image; price; quantity of 1; total price matching single item price
Actual Result: Product appears with matching name and correct details

Title: Add two different products to cart
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products; 2. Add first product; 3. Add second product; 4. Navigate to cart
Expected Result: Cart page displays 2 rows in cart table; each row shows different product name; total price is sum of both items
Actual Result: Cart shows 2 different products with correct names and prices

Title: Cart product displays price and quantity
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart; 2. Navigate to cart page; 3. Check price and quantity
Expected Result: Cart displays: price in format Rs. [amount]; quantity shown as 1; total column shows quantity × price
Actual Result: Price Rs. 500 and quantity 1 displayed correctly

Title: Update product quantity in cart
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart; 2. Navigate to cart; 3. Change quantity value to 3; 4. Verify total price updates
Expected Result: Total price column updates automatically to show 3 × unit price; cart totals section reflects new quantity in subtotal and total
Notes: Quantity update - requires additional page object methods and dynamic price calculation

Title: Remove item from cart
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart; 2. Navigate to cart; 3. Click X button on cart row
Expected Result: Product row disappears from cart table; page shows 'Cart is empty!' message or empty cart state; cart icon shows 0 items
Actual Result: Cart becomes empty with no product rows visible

Title: Add same product multiple times
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products; 2. Click Add to Cart for same product; 3. Click Continue Shopping; 4. Add same product again; 5. Navigate to cart
Expected Result: Cart displays either: (Option A) 1 row with quantity 2 OR (Option B) 2 separate rows for same product
Notes: Edge case behavior unclear - site behavior needs investigation before writing test

Title: Checkout while logged out requires login
Preconditions: Product in cart and user logged out
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart (logged out); 2. Navigate to cart; 3. Click Proceed to Checkout
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login page OR modal appears with 'Register / Login' link

Title: Checkout while logged in shows address and review
Preconditions: Product in cart and user logged in
Test Steps: 1. Login; 2. Add product to cart; 3. Navigate to cart; 4. Click Proceed to Checkout
Expected Result: Checkout page displays: delivery address section with name and address; billing address section; review order table showing product name price and quantity; total amount section
Actual Result: Delivery address and order review table both visible with correct information

Title: Complete order with payment
Preconditions: User logged in with product in cart
Test Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout; 2. Add comment; 3. Click Place Order; 4. Enter payment details; 5. Submit payment
Test Data: Comment: 'Test order'; Payment details: per site's test payment instructions
Expected Result: Order placed successfully; confirmation page shows: 'ORDER PLACED!' or 'Congratulations!' message; order number; download invoice option
Notes: Payment flow requires test card details from site documentation - do not use real payment information

Title: Verify site logo and header
Test Steps: 1. Open home page; 2. Check header section
Expected Result: Header contains: site logo image with alt text 'Website for automation practice'; navigation menu with Home Products Cart links
Notes: Visual verification - better suited for manual testing or visual regression tools

Title: Verify footer contains subscription and links
Test Steps: 1. Open any page; 2. Scroll to footer; 3. Inspect footer elements
Expected Result: Footer displays: SUBSCRIPTION heading; email input field with placeholder 'Your email address'; arrow submit button; social media icons
Notes: Static content verification - low priority for functional automation

Title: Navigate to Contact Us page
Test Steps: 1. Open home page; 2. Click Contact Us link in header; 3. Verify page loads
Expected Result: Contact Us page loads showing: 'GET IN TOUCH' heading; name email subject message fields; contact form; upload file option
Notes: Basic navigation - can be automated but lower priority than core flows

Title: Subscribe to newsletter from footer
Test Steps: 1. Open any page; 2. Scroll to footer; 3. Enter email in subscription field; 4. Click submit arrow
Expected Result: Success alert appears with message 'You have been successfully subscribed!' (alert box)
Notes: Newsletter subscription - nice-to-have feature not critical for e-commerce flow
